notes: Simplified two-stage pipeline: YOLO11n COCO FP16 for detection, EfficientNet-Lite0 INT8 for 335-class food classification. Binary gate removed (EfficientNet-Lite0 is food-only trained). Food-101 fallback removed (101 classes are a subset of 335). NMS is performed in JavaScript, not baked into models.

models.name: YOLO26n COCO Detection
models.description: YOLO26n pre-trained on COCO. 80 classes including 10 food items. NMS performed in JavaScript.

models.name: EfficientNet-Lite0 (335-Class Food Classifier)
models.description: Custom-trained EfficientNet-Lite0 on Food-101 + UEC-256 merged dataset. 335 food-specific classes, 74.17% top-1, 92.14% top-5. INT8 quantized.
